version: 0.4.1
kind: ui-framework
schema_type: object

metadata:
  udi: prismata.meta.schema.ui-framework
  name: ui-framework.schema
  description: Canonical UI framework schema.

spec:
  target_kind: ui-framework
  naming:
    file_suffix: .schema.yaml
  versioning:
    semver: true
  imports:
    - prismata.meta.schema.shared-udi-fields

fields:
  - name: id
    path: id
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: udi
    path: udi
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: panes
    path: panes
    type: array
    required: true

  - name: menus
    path: menus
    type: array
    required: false

  - name: active_pane
    path: active_pane
    type: string
    required: false

  - name: pane_bindings
    path: pane_bindings
    type: array
    required: false

  - name: colour_scheme
    path: colour_scheme
    type: string
    required: false

  - name: border_pattern
    path: border_pattern
    type: string
    required: false

object:
  id: ""
  udi: ""
  panes: []
  menus: []
  active_pane: ""
  pane_bindings: []
  colour_scheme: ""
  border_pattern: ""
